{%- liquid assign collection_handle = collection.handle | default: '' assign show_callout = false assign callout_eyebrow = '' assign callout_title = '' assign callout_body = '' assign primary_label = 'Shop the collection' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = '' assign secondary_url = '' assign tertiary_label = '' assign tertiary_url = '' assign callout_media = blank assign callout_media_source_product = blank assign callout_media_alt = collection.title | default: 'Matching collection' assign collection_live_count = collection.all_products_count | default: collection.products_count case collection_handle when 'matching-couples-t-shirts' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Shop faster' assign callout_title = 'Compare the couple tees here, then branch into broader matching looks' assign callout_body = 'Keep shoppers on the grid first so they can scan the strongest couple graphics side by side, then widen out into family matching if they want more than tees.' assign primary_label = 'Shop the tee grid' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Browse family matching' assign secondary_url = '/collections/matching-outfits' when 'mommy-and-me' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Shop faster' assign callout_title = 'Browse the full Mommy & Me collection, then jump to the newest pajamas' assign callout_body = 'Use this page as the broad matching browse first. When the shopper already knows she wants sleepwear, the dedicated pajama drop is the clean next step instead of the starting point.' assign primary_label = 'Browse this collection' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Shop new pajamas' assign secondary_url = '/collections/new-pajama-drop' assign tertiary_label = 'Browse all pajamas' assign tertiary_url = '/collections/pajamas' when 'matching-outfits', 'family-matching-outfits', 'new-women-outfits' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Shop faster' assign callout_title = 'Start with the family grid, then use the pajama launch as the focused edit' assign callout_body = 'The broad family collection should stay easy to scan above the fold. When the shopper wants the newest sleepwear specifically, route her into the pajama drop as the tighter follow-on path.' assign primary_label = 'Browse this collection' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Shop new pajamas' assign secondary_url = '/collections/new-pajama-drop' assign tertiary_label = 'Browse all pajamas' assign tertiary_url = '/collections/pajamas' when 'pajamas' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Shop faster' assign callout_title = 'See the full pajama grid first, then jump to the newest drop' assign callout_body = 'This collection works best as the main browse. Let shoppers compare every live pajama style right here, then offer the new-arrivals edit for anyone who wants the freshest prints first.' assign primary_label = 'Shop the pajamas below' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Newest arrivals' assign secondary_url = '/collections/new-pajama-drop' assign tertiary_label = 'Browse Mommy & Me' assign tertiary_url = '/collections/mommy-and-me' when 'new-pajama-drop' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Just added' assign callout_title = 'Fresh matching pajamas, all in one focused edit' assign callout_body = 'Keep the newest prints grouped together here for a tighter browse, then let shoppers widen back out into the full pajama collection when they want every live option.' assign primary_label = 'Shop new arrivals' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Browse all pajamas' assign secondary_url = '/collections/pajamas' when 'new-matching-outfits' assign show_callout = true assign callout_eyebrow = 'Fresh arrivals' assign callout_title = 'See the latest matching looks without losing the main grid' assign callout_body = 'This page should still feel easy to scan. Keep the newest arrivals visible here first, then use the broader Mommy & Me collection as the backup path when shoppers want more depth.' assign primary_label = 'Shop new arrivals' assign primary_url = '#product-grid' assign secondary_label = 'Browse Mommy & Me' assign secondary_url = '/collections/mommy-and-me' endcase if collection.image != blank assign callout_media = collection.image elsif collection.products_count > 0 and collection.products.first.featured_media != blank assign callout_media = collection.products.first.featured_media.preview_image assign callout_media_source_product = collection.products.first endif if callout_media != blank capture callout_media_alt render 'product-image-alt', product: callout_media_source_product, media: callout_media, collection: collection, fallback_title: callout_media_alt endcapture assign callout_media_alt = callout_media_alt | strip endif -%} {%- if show_callout -%}
{%- if callout_eyebrow != blank -%}

{{ callout_eyebrow }}

{%- endif -%}

{{ callout_title }}

{{ callout_body }}

{%- endif -%}
{%- endif -%}

{%- liquid
  assign collection_handle = collection.handle | default: ''

  assign force_theme_seo = false

  case collection_handle
    when 'all'

    when 'mommy-and-me-easter-dresses', 'easter-matching-outfits', 'spring-matching-outfits'

    when 'tops'

      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.tops'
    when 'pajamas', 'family-pajamas'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Family Pajamas'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.pajamas'
    when 'sweaters'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Sweaters and Jackets'

    when 'maxi-dresses'

    when 'mini-dresses'

    when 'rompers'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Rompers'

    when 'sundresses'

      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.sundresses'
    when 'bottoms'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Bottoms'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.bottoms'
    when 'skirts'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Skirts'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.skirts'
    when 'leggings'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Leggings'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.leggings'
    when 'pants'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Pants'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.pants'
    when 'new-arrivals'

      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.new_arrivals'
    when 'new-matching-outfits'
      assign effective_display_title = 'New Mommy and Me Outfits'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.new_matching_outfits'
    when 'maternity'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Maternity and Nursing Styles'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.maternity'
    when 'best-sellers'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Best Sellers'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.best_sellers'
    when 'popular-mommy-me-1'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Popular Mommy and Me'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.popular_mommy_me'
    when 'popular-family-matching'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Popular Family Matching Outfits'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.popular_family_matching'
    when 'matching-hawaiian-outfits'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Family Hawaiian Outfits'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.hawaiian_outfits'
    when 'trunks'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Swim Trunks'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.trunks'
    when 'fall-winter'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Fall and Winter Matching Outfits'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.fall_winter'
    when 'formal-dresses'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Matching Formal Dresses'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.formal_dresses'
    when 'family-sweaters'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Family Sweaters and Jackets'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.family_sweaters'
    when 'christmas-sweaters'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Christmas Matching Sweaters'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.christmas_sweaters'
    when 'christmas-tops'
      assign effective_display_title = 'Christmas Matching Tops'
      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.christmas_tops'
    when 'christmas-pajamas'

      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.christmas_pajamas'

      assign effective_display_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.display_titles.valentines'
  endcase

  if effective_display_title_key != blank
    assign effective_display_title = effective_display_title_key | t
  endif

  assign effective_meta_title = effective_display_title
  if collection_handle == 'swimsuits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Matching Family Swimsuits | Mom & Daughter'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.swimsuits'
  elsif collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Mommy and Me Outfits | Dresses, Swimsuits and Matching Sets'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.mommy_and_me'
  elsif collection_handle == 'family-swimsuits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Matching Family Bathing Suits | Family Swimwear'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.family_swimsuits'
  elsif collection_handle == 'family-sets' or collection_handle == 'matching-family-vacation-outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Matching Family Vacation Outfits | Beach and Travel Sets'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.family_sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'family-matching' or collection_handle == 'family-matching-outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Family Matching Outfits | Mommy and Me'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.family_matching'
  elsif collection_handle == 'new-women-outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Family Matching Outfits | Dresses, Swimwear and Family Sets'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.new_women_outfits'
  elsif collection_handle == 'dresses' or collection_handle == 'mother-daughter-matching-dresses'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Mommy and Me Dresses | Mother Daughter'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.dresses'
  elsif collection_handle == 'maxi-dresses'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Matching Maxi Dresses | Mom and Daughter'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.maxi_dresses'
  elsif collection_handle == 'best-sellers'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Best-Selling Mommy and Me Outfits | Dresses, Swimsuits and More'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.best_sellers'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me' or collection_handle == 'daddy-and-me'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Daddy and Me Shirts, Tees and Matching Outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.daddy_me'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me-t-shirts'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Daddy and Me Shirts | Matching Tees for Dads and Kids'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.daddy_me_tshirts'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me-shirts'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Dad and Son Matching Shirts | Button-Up, Dress and Hawaiian'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.daddy_me_shirts'
  elsif collection_handle == 'couples'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Couples Matching Outfits | Coordinated Looks for Him and Her'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.couples'
  elsif collection_handle == 'matching-couples-t-shirts'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Couples Matching Shirts | Couple T-Shirts and Tees'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.couples_tshirts'
  elsif collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me-easter-dresses' or collection_handle == 'easter-matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'spring-matching-outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title = 'Mommy and Me Easter Dresses | Spring Matching Outfits'
    assign effective_meta_title_key = 'sections.collection_seo.meta_titles.spring_matching'
  endif

  if effective_meta_title_key != blank
    assign effective_meta_title = effective_meta_title_key | t
  endif

  if collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me' or collection_handle == 'swimsuits' or collection_handle == 'family-swimsuits' or collection_handle == 'family-sets' or collection_handle == 'matching-family-vacation-outfits' or collection_handle == 'matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'family-matching' or collection_handle == 'family-matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'new-women-outfits' or collection_handle == 'dresses' or collection_handle == 'mother-daughter-matching-dresses' or collection_handle == 'maxi-dresses' or collection_handle == 'daddy-me' or collection_handle == 'daddy-and-me' or collection_handle == 'daddy-me-t-shirts' or collection_handle == 'matching-couples-t-shirts' or collection_handle == 'family-pajamas'
    assign force_theme_seo = true
  endif

  assign audience_long = 'moms, kids, and coordinated family looks'
  assign product_examples_short = 'dresses, tops, pajamas, swimwear, and seasonal layers'
  assign occasion_label = 'family photos, holidays, vacations, and everyday wear'

  if collection_handle == 'all'
    assign audience_long = 'families, couples, moms, dads, and kids'
    assign product_examples_short = 'mommy and me, daddy and me, couples, and family sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me'
    assign audience_long = 'moms and daughters shopping for photo-ready coordinated looks'
    assign product_examples_short = 'mommy and me dresses, swimsuits, pajamas, and coordinated sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me-easter-dresses' or collection_handle == 'easter-matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'spring-matching-outfits'
    assign audience_long = 'moms and daughters planning Easter, spring photos, church, brunches, and seasonal celebrations'
    assign product_examples_short = 'Easter dresses, spring florals, pastel sets, and photo-ready matching outfits'
  elsif collection_handle == 'swimsuits'
    assign audience_long = 'moms, daughters, and families building coordinated swim looks'
    assign product_examples_short = 'mommy and me swimsuits, one-pieces, bikinis, rash guards, and swim trunks'
  elsif collection_handle == 'family-swimsuits'
    assign audience_long = 'families planning beach trips, pool days, cruises, and resort photos'
    assign product_examples_short = 'matching family bathing suits, one-pieces, bikinis, rash guards, cover-ups, and swim trunks'
  elsif collection_handle == 'family-sets' or collection_handle == 'matching-family-vacation-outfits'
    assign audience_long = 'families planning beach trips, cruises, resort travel, and warm-weather photo moments'
    assign product_examples_short = 'matching family vacation outfits, beach sets, dresses, tops, and travel-ready coordinated looks'
  elsif collection_handle == 'new-women-outfits'
    assign audience_long = 'families and shoppers comparing coordinated looks before narrowing into a specific occasion'
    assign product_examples_short = 'family matching outfits, dresses, swimwear, mommy and me looks, and travel-ready sets'
    assign occasion_label = 'family photos, trips, holidays, seasonal updates, and everyday coordination'
  elsif collection_handle == 'matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'family-matching' or collection_handle == 'family-matching-outfits'
    assign audience_long = 'the whole family, from babies and toddlers to parents'
    assign product_examples_short = 'coordinated dresses, tops, swimwear, sets, and seasonal matching looks'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me' or collection_handle == 'daddy-and-me'
    assign audience_long = 'dads and kids shopping matching tees, shirts, and coordinated outfits'
    assign product_examples_short = 'graphic tees, button-down shirts, Hawaiian shirts, swim trunks, and easy matching sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me-t-shirts'
    assign audience_long = 'dads and kids shopping casual matching tees and giftable tops'
    assign product_examples_short = 'graphic tees, slogan shirts, and easy everyday matching tops'
  elsif collection_handle == 'daddy-me-shirts'
    assign audience_long = 'dads and sons shopping polished button-up, dress shirt, and Hawaiian looks'
    assign product_examples_short = 'button-down shirts, dress shirts, Hawaiian shirts, and photo-ready matching sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'couples'
    assign audience_long = 'couples shopping coordinated looks for date nights, travel, holidays, and gifts'
    assign product_examples_short = 'matching tops, tees, pajamas, vacation looks, and giftable sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'matching-couples-t-shirts'
    assign audience_long = 'couples shopping casual matching shirts for trips, gifts, and everyday wear'
    assign product_examples_short = 'couple shirts, matching tees, graphic tops, and easy coordinated looks'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'christmas'
    assign audience_long = 'the whole family during the holiday season'
    assign product_examples_short = 'festive pajamas, sweaters, tops, and holiday-ready sets'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'valentines'
    assign audience_long = 'families, couples, and moms with kids celebrating together'
    assign product_examples_short = 'festive tops, dresses, pajamas, and coordinated sets'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'mommy' or collection_handle == 'best-sellers' or collection_handle == 'popular-mommy-me-1' or collection_handle == 'new-matching-outfits'
    assign audience_long = 'moms and daughters who want easy, photo-ready coordination'
    assign product_examples_short = 'dresses, swimwear, pajamas, and photo-ready sets'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'daddy'
    assign audience_long = 'dads and kids who want easy matching looks'
    assign product_examples_short = 'tees, shirts, swimwear, and coordinated sets'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'couples'
    assign audience_long = 'couples shopping for date nights, trips, holidays, and gifts'
    assign product_examples_short = 'tees, pajamas, vacation looks, and giftable sets'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'family' or collection_handle == 'matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'popular-family-matching'

    assign product_examples_short = 'dresses, pajamas, swimwear, tops, and seasonal sets'
  elsif collection_handle == 'maternity'
    assign audience_long = 'pregnancy, nursing, and postpartum comfort'
    assign product_examples_short = 'bump-friendly dresses, soft basics, and nursing-friendly silhouettes'
  elsif collection_handle == 'trunks'
    assign audience_long = 'dads, boys, and coordinated family swim looks'
    assign product_examples_short = 'swim trunks, rash guards, and coordinated beach-ready styles'
  endif

  if collection_handle contains 'christmas'
    assign occasion_label = 'Christmas morning, holiday photos, winter parties, and cozy nights in'
  elsif collection_handle contains 'valentines'
    assign occasion_label = "Valentine's Day photos, gifts, date nights, and special outings"
  elsif collection_handle == 'mommy-and-me-easter-dresses' or collection_handle == 'easter-matching-outfits' or collection_handle == 'spring-matching-outfits'

  elsif collection_handle == 'fall-winter'
    assign occasion_label = 'cool-weather outings, family photos, holiday events, and cozy weekends'

    assign occasion_label = 'family photos, beach trips, cruises, dinners, weddings, and dressier events'
  elsif collection_handle == 'swimsuits' or collection_handle == 'family-swimsuits'
    assign occasion_label = 'beach trips, pool days, cruises, resort travel, and summer family photos'
  elsif collection_handle == 'couples'
    assign occasion_label = 'date nights, trips, holidays, engagement photos, anniversaries, and coordinated everyday wear'
